description: List the venues (restaurants, bars, beach clubs…) that can be booked on Upsalt, 20 per page, sorted by name. Filter by city, business type, venue name, or cuisine/concept tag. Each result gives the company_id and slug for the other tools, the address, the weekly opening hours, the cuisines and tags, and the public booking page URL. Use this when the user has no venue in mind yet.

city.description: Town or postcode, e.g. "Nice" or "06000". Accents and case are ignored.

lang.description: Language of the cuisine and tag labels: en (default), fr, es or it.

page.description: Page number, from 1. meta.last_page gives the number of pages.

tag.description: Cuisine or concept, as a word in English, French, Spanish or Italian ("japanese", "bistronomie", "vegan", "rooftop") or as a tag key ("cuisine.asia.japan"). A broad cuisine also finds the precise ones: "asian" finds Japanese venues.
